zodiac.name: Aries
zodiac.desc: Bold, energetic, and pioneering. Aries spaces should inspire passion, action, and physical vitality while maintaining active harmony.
zodiac.color: Crimson, terracotta, rustic orange, gold, and clean white accents. Avoid pure black and deep indigo which restrict energy flow.
zodiac.furniture: Dynamic clean lines, leather accents, polished copper or brass trims, statement lounge chairs, and modular setups.
zodiac.layout: Ensure active open space in the South/East quadrant. Place a bold energy-focused element in the South corner.
zodiac.lighting: Warm, radiant lighting with dimmers, accent track lights highlighting raw materials, and ample natural sunlight ingress.
zodiac.decor: Copper artifacts, textured warm rugs, geometric art, and active, upward-growing indoor plants (like Areca palms).
zodiac.mistakes: Cluttering the entry with cool blue colors, blocking southern windows, or placing heavy dark storage in the East.
zodiac.roomRecs: Optimize the living room or private home gym/study zone with fire-element finishes to channel focus and productivity.

zodiac.name: Taurus
zodiac.desc: Sensual, grounded, and luxury-loving. Taurus spaces focus on tactile comfort, premium materials, and stable organic geometry.
zodiac.color: Sage green, warm beige, soft creams, olive, and rose gold details. Avoid cold corporate greys.
zodiac.furniture: Plush velvet sofas, heavy solid oak dining tables, organic rounded edges, and deep lounge seating.
zodiac.layout: Ground coordinates in the South-West quadrant. Keep the center (Brahmasthan) exceptionally open and light.
zodiac.lighting: Soft diffused warm ambient lighting, statement glass chandeliers, and cozy reading lamps.
zodiac.decor: Lush indoor foliage, ceramic vessels, linen drapes, tactile woven tapestries, and serene nature landscape art.
zodiac.mistakes: Using cold metallic/steel surfaces, placing mirrors directly opposite the bed, or introducing loud color contrasts.
zodiac.roomRecs: Focus on bedroom or dining lounge alignment, using heavy textures and calming Earth elements to ground relationships.

zodiac.name: Gemini
zodiac.desc: Intellectual, communicative, and versatile. Gemini homes require multi-functional layouts, stimulating elements, and social seating grids.
zodiac.color: Soft yellow, light green, airy sky blue, ivory, and light birch wood tones. Avoid heavy mahogany.
zodiac.furniture: Modular shelving, nesting coffee tables, light ergonomic chairs, and dual-purpose home office tables.
zodiac.layout: Create an active social circle or workspace facing North/North-East. Place study desks facing North.
zodiac.lighting: Bright, natural day-lit windows, cool task lighting for focus, and dynamic smart-color bulbs.
zodiac.decor: Book collections, maps, green plants, modern abstract canvas art, and statement mirrors reflecting light.
zodiac.mistakes: Blocking air circulation, placing desks facing a blank solid wall, or dark window treatments that limit daylight.
zodiac.roomRecs: Optimize the study room, home library, or living room chat corner to stimulate intellectual growth and easy communication.

zodiac.name: Cancer
zodiac.desc: Nurturing, intuitive, and deeply sentimental. Cancer homes are true emotional sanctuaries designed for ultimate security and family connection.
zodiac.color: Seafoam green, pearl white, silver, soft grey, cream, and iridescent accents. Avoid aggressive crimson.
zodiac.furniture: Slipcovered sofas, vintage chest of drawers, cozy window seats, and oval soft dining tables.
zodiac.layout: Prioritize the North/North-West quadrant. Ensure the bedroom bed orientation optimizes lunar directions.
zodiac.lighting: Diffused moon-like soft white light, salt lamps, and candlelight accents for cozy evening warmth.
zodiac.decor: Family galleries, silver accessories, crystal dishes, organic cotton throws, and subtle water elements (like indoor table fountains).
zodiac.mistakes: Using sharp angular metallic tables, placing the bed directly in line with the entryway, or cold minimalistic styling.
zodiac.roomRecs: Sanctify the master bedroom, kitchen, or cozy reading nook to support mental rejuvenation and close relationships.

zodiac.name: Leo
zodiac.desc: Majestic, expressive, and warm. Leo spaces feature theatrical accents, premium statement pieces, and sun-aligned radiant layouts.
zodiac.color: Gold, amber, warm mustard, bronze, deep purple, and rich royal cream. Avoid dull drab shades.
zodiac.furniture: Sculptural accent chairs, high headboard beds, grand dining tables, and gilded mirror frames.
zodiac.layout: Optimize the East quadrant to capture the auspicious solar rays. Seating should face East or North.
zodiac.lighting: Grand brass/gold chandeliers, sunburst mirrors reflecting ambient light, and bright warm light fixtures.
zodiac.decor: Fine art, velvet cushions, gold-leaf finishes, statement centerpieces, and bold floral arrangements.
zodiac.mistakes: Dimly lit corridors, placing low-quality synthetic rugs, or blocking early morning sunlight from the East.
zodiac.roomRecs: Elevate the formal living room, foyer entrance, or drawing room with solar motifs to command respect and prestige.

zodiac.name: Virgo
zodiac.desc: Discerning, organic, and highly organized. Virgo layouts require clean symmetry, meticulous storage systems, and soothing materials.
zodiac.color: Soft taupe, wheat, eucalyptus green, clean white, and light terracotta accents. Avoid overwhelming primary colors.
zodiac.furniture: Bespoke built-in cabinetry, floating desk layouts, solid wooden frames, and concealed smart storage.
zodiac.layout: Ensure a clutter-free North-West quadrant. Desk layouts must be perfectly balanced and uncluttered.
zodiac.lighting: Adjustable LED task lights, natural direct sunlight, and soft perimeter warm profile lights.
zodiac.decor: Botanical prints, organized books, handmade pottery, linen fabrics, and air-purifying plants (snake plants).
zodiac.mistakes: Exposed wiring clutter, using noisy color patterns, or placing bulky cabinets that block corner windows.
zodiac.roomRecs: Optimize the study room, kitchen work area, or utility closet to streamline daily efficiency and mental peace.

zodiac.name: Libra
zodiac.desc: Harmonious, artistic, and symmetrical. Libra spaces focus on visual balance, sophisticated art curations, and social design elegance.
zodiac.color: Powder blue, dusty pink, lavender, warm cream, and polished brass highlights. Avoid harsh high-contrast colors.
zodiac.furniture: Symmetrical twin lounge chairs, glass-topped coffee tables, delicate consoles, and elegant curved chaise lounges.
zodiac.layout: Keep structural layouts strictly symmetrical. Balance heavy elements on both sides of a room's center axis.
zodiac.lighting: Dimmable crystal chandeliers, balanced twin table lamps, and soft translucent window sheers.
zodiac.decor: Fine art paintings, sculptural marble busts, fresh pastel roses, and high-quality design mirrors.
zodiac.mistakes: Asymmetrical furniture layout, heavy dark drapes, or cluttering the entrance corridor.
zodiac.roomRecs: Optimize the master suite, guest bedroom, or dining hall with Venus-aligned textures to nurture love and social life.

zodiac.name: Scorpio
zodiac.desc: Intense, private, and transformational. Scorpio spaces are mysterious, cozy sanctuaries crafted with deep tones and private layout boundaries.
zodiac.color: Deep burgundy, charcoal black, rich emerald, plum, and copper details. Avoid high-glare white walls.
zodiac.furniture: Dark wood bed frames, low-slung leather sofas, deep velvet reading chairs, and built-in bookshelves.
zodiac.layout: Focus on the South-West or deep private quadrants. Bedrooms should feel cocooned and secluded.
zodiac.lighting: Low ambient mood lighting, smart dimming systems, hidden LED light strips, and accent candle lighting.
zodiac.decor: Rich textured carpets, abstract dark canvas prints, geodes/crystals, and heavy acoustic drapes.
zodiac.mistakes: Having too many mirrors in the bedroom, bright fluorescent lights, or high street-noise exposure.
zodiac.roomRecs: Optimize the master bedroom, home theater, or private study room for deep reflection and mental recharge.

zodiac.name: Sagittarius
zodiac.desc: Adventurous, philosophical, and expansive. Sagittarius designs need open vistas, travel inspiration, and optimistic bright rooms.
zodiac.color: Indigo blue, saffron orange, rich yellow, turquoise, and gold-trimmed details. Avoid dark, cold greys.
zodiac.furniture: Large rustic wooden tables, comfortable daybeds, floor cushions, and double-height bookshelves.
zodiac.layout: Ensure high ceilings or the illusion of height. Position seating areas facing wide windows or open views.
zodiac.lighting: Natural sunlight, tall floor lamps casting light upwards, and bright welcoming entry lights.
zodiac.decor: Travel collections, vintage globes, global textiles, philosophy books, and tall, broad-leaf plants.
zodiac.mistakes: Cramped low-ceiling feel, small blocked windows, or boring sterile minimalistic furniture.
zodiac.roomRecs: Optimize the family lounge, home library, or double-height dining room to invite expansion and wisdom.

zodiac.name: Capricorn
zodiac.desc: Ambitious, structured, and timeless. Capricorn homes showcase architectural legacy, solid craftsmanship, and functional structure.
zodiac.color: Slate grey, deep forest green, chocolate brown, granite black, and brass trims. Avoid childish neon palettes.
zodiac.furniture: Solid oak desks, executive high-back leather chairs, stone-topped consoles, and architectural tables.
zodiac.layout: Orient rooms toward the West or South-West. Ensure structural lines are straight, sharp, and clean.
zodiac.lighting: Warm direct spotlighting, desk lamps, and warm perimeter lights. Avoid clinical cool white LEDs.
zodiac.decor: Vintage clocks, structural models, black-and-white photography, stone sculptures, and structured bonsai trees.
zodiac.mistakes: Flimsy plastic furniture, messy papers on display, or lack of defined structural borders in rooms.
zodiac.roomRecs: Optimize the executive home office, study cabin, or formal boardroom for professional authority and success.

zodiac.name: Aquarius
zodiac.desc: Visionary, unconventional, and humanitarian. Aquarius designs combine smart home technology, futuristic layouts, and unique decor.
zodiac.color: Electric blue, metallic silver, clean steel grey, pure white, and sky highlights. Avoid heavy rustic designs.
zodiac.furniture: Ergonomic glass/metal tables, floating shelves, futuristic geometric chairs, and modular layout zones.
zodiac.layout: Open-concept layout with continuous airflow. Position study desks in the North-East facing coordinates.
zodiac.lighting: Integrated smart home LED systems, cool blue backlighting, and modern minimalistic pendant fixtures.
zodiac.decor: Tech integrations, abstract geometric panels, modern art, air purifiers, and aeroponic vertical plants.
zodiac.mistakes: Closed dark partitions, cluttered corners, or choosing traditional dark-heavy wood styling.
zodiac.roomRecs: Optimize the home media room, studio, or high-tech workspace for creative innovation and collaborative flow.

zodiac.name: Pisces
zodiac.desc: Dreamy, spiritual, and artistic. Pisces spaces should feel like tranquil retreats designed for meditation, music, and quiet healing.
zodiac.color: Aquamarine, seafoam, lavender, soft pearl white, and silver. Avoid harsh high-energy neon reds.
zodiac.furniture: Comfortable daybeds, hanging chairs, low floor seating, and rounded light-wood tables.
zodiac.layout: Optimize the North-East quadrant (Ishanya) for peaceful meditation. Keep the entry clear and light.
zodiac.lighting: Soft under-cabinet lighting, warm fairy lights, salt crystal lamps, and diffused natural day sheers.
zodiac.decor: Meditation cushions, wind chimes, ocean art, musical instruments, and fresh water bowls with lotus flowers.
zodiac.mistakes: Using heavy sharp iron furniture, noise pollution, or keeping broken artifacts and dry plastic plants.
zodiac.roomRecs: Focus on the home temple (Pooja room), yoga/meditation corner, or master bath suite for emotional healing.

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.desc: The primary sanctuary for rejuvenation. Align bed orientations to optimize lunar coordinates, ensuring deep sleep and relational harmony.

rooms.name: Living Room
rooms.desc: The social center. Balance heavy structural elements with light sheers and active air circulation to foster warm conversations.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.desc: The elemental fire kitchen coordinates. Calibrate clay/terracotta textures and warm lighting tones to promote health and vitality.

rooms.name: Study Room
rooms.desc: Optimized for learning and focus. Position study desks facing North or East, and select Mercury-supportive color spects.

rooms.name: Temple (Pooja Room)
rooms.desc: The spiritual high-vibe core. Keep layout materials soft, use pure white marble finishes, and light oil lamp accents.

rooms.name: Balcony
rooms.desc: A dynamic breathing space. Hang brass wind chimes and place light, active green foliage to filter refreshing prana.

rooms.name: Children's Room
rooms.desc: Supports restful sleep and active play. Use light wooden frames, smart study corners, and pastel colors to balance energy.

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.desc: The place of nourishment. Select circular or soft-edged dining layouts, solid wood structures, and warm golden lighting.

rooms.name: Executive Office
rooms.desc: Command configurations for leadership. Orient executive seating to face North/East, using premium wood and steel trims.

rooms.name: Medical Clinic
rooms.desc: Designed for healing and trust. Keep colors sterile but welcoming (soft greys, greens) and optimize reception energy.

rooms.name: Hotel Suite
rooms.desc: Evoke immediate sensory delight. Utilize plush textures, custom brass fittings, and drapes to balance guest horoscopes.

rooms.name: Restaurant Lounge
rooms.desc: Promote high guest retention. Balance structural tables with element lighting and color to stimulate social mood.

rooms.name: Retail Showroom
rooms.desc: Maximize commercial circulation and sales. Align cash registers to wealth coordinates, keeping paths clear and bright.

colours.name: Blue
colours.impact: Promotes deep relaxation, introspection, and sleep quality. Calms communication pathways.

colours.name: White
colours.impact: Evokes clarity, purity, expansive space, and quiet focus. Ideal for home temples and modern living zones.

colours.name: Green
colours.impact: Encourages growth, balance, mental sharp focus, and wealth. Excellent for workspaces and kitchens.

colours.name: Yellow
colours.impact: Inspires wisdom, positive optimism, joy, and digestive energy. Perfect for dining halls and studies.

colours.name: Orange
colours.impact: Sparks creativity, social connection, and high energy. Use as key accents in social areas or entry foyers.

colours.name: Grey
colours.impact: Provides structured grounding, neutrality, and clean modern styling. Best balanced with warm golden accents.

colours.name: Gold
colours.impact: Signifies prestige, wealth flow, success, and high luxury. Activates solar energy in primary rooms.

colours.name: Silver
colours.impact: Nurtures emotional calm, artistic design harmony, and mental focus. Complements soft pastel styling.

colours.name: Red
colours.impact: Invokes strong passion, dynamic action, and courage. Best restricted to small accents in the South quadrant.

colours.name: Pink
colours.impact: Inspires romance, domestic bliss, gentleness, and empathy. Ideal for master bedroom coordinates.

colours.name: Brown
colours.impact: Grounds anxiety, provides stability, and connects with nature. Best used via natural wood finishes.

colours.name: Black
colours.impact: Adds high-end luxury styling depth, mystery, and grounding limits. Best used in moderation for accents.
